title: Deinococcus radiodurans survives three years in space on the ISS

plain: A tough bacterium called Deinococcus radiodurans is said to have survived three years in open space during experiments on the International Space Station. A guest named Dr. Gilbert mentions this to Michels without naming the studies. If true, it suggests simple life could survive a journey between worlds.
